name: Shebakia with Amlou Dip
description: Crispy fried sesame cookies served alongside amlou, a luscious dip of argan oil, almonds, and honey.
ingredients: a handful of fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with smen (preserved butter).
In a large bowl, whisk together the vermicelli noodles and saffron threads until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the pitted dates with the water until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 20 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
Garnish with parsley or a dusting of green olives.
tips: Resist opening the oven door too early — a sudden change in temperature can cause the dessert to sink or crack.
This keeps well for a couple of days in an airtight container, and the flavor often improves overnight.
Bring your pitted dates to room temperature before mixing for a smoother, more even texture.
